ringmaster.line: The lion bows his head down to the ringmaster
ringmaster.lineNext: With the tightrope stretched so high above the crowd
stanza: The lion bows his head down to the ringmaster
With the tightrope stretched so high above the crowd
All these faces are contortionists, it must have hurt
Because they all looked as unhappy as a clown
